lane: two-view co-training (Blum & Mitchell 1998, doi:10.1145/279943.279962); View A potential-field/subsurface, View B surface; disagreement as the discovery signal; cover-gated A-only emission (H66-A)

h66a_field.cover_prior: raw_band_15 log1p, min-max normalised over the allowed domain
h66a_field.formula: (rankA - rankB) * cover_norm inside the gate, -1 elsewhere
h66a_field.placement: gems52.nodes.spacing_select, min 3 px separation, 9400 dots per fold per arm

experiments: E1 leakage canary + fit + independence screen (mandated empirical test)
E2 one pseudo-label exchange + hide-and-recover holdout, 7 arms (6 H61 arms + h66a_cover_gated_a_only)
E3 build + gates + unique GeoTIFF + run card
budget.deferred: H66-B two-round exchange; H66-C strain-seismicity View A; H66-D long-wavelength deep-edge View A; H66-E B-only control

verdict_rule: promote only if format+lane(policy)+unique+not-union pass AND h66a beats single_B on the pooled holdout with the paired 95% CI entirely above 0; otherwise negative/research-only

amendments.note: budget-as-cap over the gate support; written when the build stage first ran
